## Appearance

Hester Gray is described as a small girl with soft eyes. She has dark hair that is easily ruffled by the wind.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P40](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0040)_

## History

Hester Gray is a figure whose story becomes a subject of interest for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends. During a group outing, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her companions discuss Hester's background and imagine what she looked like in the past. After reflecting on her history, they leave their baskets in the garden before continuing to explore the surrounding woods and fields.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P62](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0062), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P63](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0063), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P65](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0065), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), +6 more_
